metadata.title: Federal Register rule-flow public proxy as compliance-exposed ETF RV regime signal

federal_register.alignment: publication_date assigned to first target ETF trading date >= publication_date; tested signal then shift(1)

methodology.proxy_limit: Federal Register RULE/PRORULE flow is a public regulatory-activity proxy. It is not RegData restriction intensity, OIRA paperwork burden, firm legal spend, or true compliance-labor exposure.
methodology.signal_construction: Rule/proposed-rule publication counts are aligned to the next ETF trading date; 5d and 21d log-count rolling z-scores use baselines ending at t-1. Tested predictors are signal.shift(1).
methodology.forward_target: Forward outcomes use close-to-close / volume realizations strictly in [t+1, t+H].
methodology.primary_regression: Controlled HAC OLS: forward outcome ~ signal_lag1 + own_log_RV21_lag1 + SPY_log_RV21_lag1 + VIX_level_lag1, with downside/volume lag controls added for matching outcomes.
methodology.hac_lag: HAC maxlags equals forecast horizon H.
methodology.spearman_ci: moving-block bootstrap with block=H, B=1000, seed=42.
methodology.auc_ci: Hanley-McNeil normal approximation for left-tail event AUC.
methodology.primary_family: 8 targets x 2 horizons x 3 outcomes x 3 signals = 144 controlled-HAC p-values.
methodology.success_gate: Positive controlled-HAC coefficient must survive Bonferroni/Holm family correction; AUC and Spearman are supporting diagnostics only.

verdict_assessment.rationale: Some positive controlled coefficients are raw-significant, but no positive primary cell survives the full family correction.
